primary_metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
uncertainty: One verified Java SQL path after a bounded Maven Central search (three queries, 143 hits) and deps.dev direct dependents summed over releases for 11 targeted leads, captured 2026-11-17. org.jooq:jooq 3.21.9 (4,574 summed direct dependents) parses both valid controls with SQLDialect.DEFAULT into its query object model, which gives the oracle summary. Its dependents mostly use jOOQ as a query builder, not its parser. jOOQ's generic QOM traversal API is not in the open-source jar, so the adapter walks typed QOM accessors and the operators' $args(). Druid, presto-parser, Calcite, JSqlParser, Trino and other leads are unverified, so this is not a top-ten ranking. java.sql has no SQL parser. Two valid controls establish only the tested dialect-neutral subset.
